column1: # WP-T3 spike-regeneration manifest, read by test/t3-regen.sh.
# One row per regeneration script. A spike directory that holds more than one
# characterization script gets one row each -- abi-crossing and map-and-jump
# carry a second, root-differential script (characterize-*) beside the main one,
# and each script owns its own transcript. The fetch-* scripts in some spikes
# stage inputs rather than regenerate a transcript and are not listed.
# Columns, TAB-separated:
#   dir        directory under spike/
#   needs      an input path that must exist for the rerun to be possible
#              (- when none, SKIP to list the spike but not run it)
#   transcript a glob under spike/dir naming the committed transcript this
#              script regenerates; the runner diffs against the newest match.
#              A script and its transcript must be paired here by name, because
#              "newest results-*.txt" alone pairs a script with a sibling's
#              transcript when a directory holds several.
#   command    the regeneration command, run from inside the spike directory,
#              writing the transcript to stdout.
# A row fails when its command produces no transcript, or when the findings no
# longer match its paired transcript; it is skipped when needs is absent or SKIP.
# dir<TAB>needs<TAB>transcript<TAB>command
abi-crossing
abi-crossing
map-and-jump
map-and-jump
redzone-delivery
gs-thread-pointer
fs-base-fault
fs-base-persistence
ld-tls-relaxation
vendor-image-shape
# vendor-hardened-build cross-builds bzip2 twice, so its rerun costs a minute
# rather than a second; it needs the cross toolchain, not just the el8 dump.
vendor-hardened-build
# rtld-lift-survey reads pinned FreeBSD sources and needs no toolchain; the
# fetch is its only prerequisite, so it has no `needs` beyond network reach.
rtld-lift-survey
triple-fidelity
versioned-libc
# demand-census regenerates by re-running the detached, resumable census over
# every package (outputs under results/, work under a/census-work), not by a
# quick transcript rerun this runner can time and diff; skipped here.
demand-census
# cygwin-from-source has no standalone regeneration script: its rerun is WP-26's
# from-source DLL build, tracked in that package rather than here.
cygwin-from-source
# reent-bringup contrasts the cygload and real-process host shapes against
# the faced DLL; its rerun needs that uncommitted build product, so it is
# checked where the DLL is built and INCOMPLETE (not run) elsewhere.
reent-bringup
# reent-stub-link measures how far the real-process relink of the loader stub
# gets: it links, but the standalone stub faults before entry.
reent-stub-link
# reent-stub-faceload measures item 1's face-base half: a real process of
# the faced runtime reaches elfsysv1.dll's base without the 1114 cygheap wedge.
reent-stub-faceload
# reent-veneer-runtime measures what the WP-53 libc.so.6 veneer, built today,
# provides for item 2: the reent surface yes, a live reent body no (all stubs).
reent-veneer-runtime
# reent-veneer-body measures item 2's target surface: every forward-map
# target is a real face export, yet a link-time forward self-references, so the
# bodies must be runtime-resolving thunks against the WP-27 crossing.
reent-veneer-body
# reent-veneer-thunk measures the link-time shape of item 2's runtime-
# resolving thunk: it names the faced target as data and holds no ELF
# dependency on it, so nothing self-binds -- the codegen contract.
reent-veneer-thunk
# reent-veneer-face-exports measures item 2's name axis: every FUNC forward
# thunk keys on a name the WP-27 face exports, across the whole forward set,
# so the run-time resolver's walk finds an export for each.
reent-veneer-face-exports
# reent-stub-realproc-window locates the real-process stub fault: not a window
# collision but the crt0 cygwin_internal ABI crossing; a bridge reaches main.
reent-stub-realproc-window
# reent-stub-libc-crossing measures item 1's open half: a host->faced libc
# call crosses through a sysv_abi thunk -- reent-free (strlen) and reent-
# consuming stdio (puts) both -- so the boundary is the ABI direction, not reent.
reent-stub-libc-crossing
# reent-stub-realproc-version composes the two fixes at the version path
# reent-stub-link found faulting: bridge + a sysv_abi-thunked stdio print,
# so a real-process stub reaches and completes its --version.
reent-stub-realproc-version
# reent-stub-stderr-crossing measures the stderr twin of the landed rp_puts
# route: the faced DLL exports no stderr FILE*, and both fd-2 bodies cross --
# write(2,s,n) raw and dprintf(2,"%s",s) variadic -- so the reroute has a route.
reent-stub-stderr-crossing
# reent-stub-path resolves item 1's open path question (SLURP-REROUTE.md):
# CreateFileA needs a Windows path; the parent (host cygwin1.dll) converts the
# POSIX mount path, the stub's host-safe GetFullPathName cannot. Native, no faced DLL.
reent-stub-path
# reent-stub-realproc-run composes the item-1 fixes on the actual loader
# source: stub.c links in the real-process shape, reaches --version across the
# faced runtime, and its window diagnostic crosses fd 2. Needs the faced DLL.
reent-stub-realproc-run
# reent-stub-realproc-faceload drives the real-process stub through the WP-41
# front end: the plain-PE control receives the low-window handover, the
# real-process (cygwin-linked) child is refused it -- the low region is already
# held at suspend. Needs the faced DLL.
reent-stub-realproc-faceload
# reent-stub-realproc-window-occupant walks the suspended cygwin-linked child
# and measures what refuses the DR-0028 handover: a private MEM_RESERVE region
# over the low ~2 MB at 0x400000, made before any user code -- the runtime own
# low reservation, colliding with the window's base. Needs the WP-26 build tree.
reent-stub-realproc-window-occupant
# reent-stub-realproc-window-reconcile drives the real elf_window_reserve_in
# (its DR-0068/0069 reconcile fallback) against a real cygwin-linked child.
# The reconcile is refused: the low window is not the bare MEM_RESERVE the
# planner models but reserved+committed, and elf_window_plan refuses a
# committed occupant. Re-aims item 1. Needs the WP-26 build tree.
reent-stub-realproc-window-reconcile
# reent-realproc-low-window drives the faced runtime's own mmap, as a real
# process of it (WP-26 crt0 + -lcygwin), placing MAP_FIXED at ELF_WINDOW_BASE
# on the _dll_crt0 main thread. Cleared: the low window is free in a sole-runtime
# process, so the fixed low region maps where the foreign-child handover was
# refused. The measurement the faced-runtime-hosting shape turns on. Needs the
# WP-26 build tree.
reent-realproc-low-window
